change.title: pr-80528-flat
change.description: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: Computed `config` with humanized schedule_type is discarded; raw `monitor.config` is returned
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds a copy of the config and swaps `schedule_type` for its display value (lines 160-162). The returned dict then uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (line 168), so the copy is never used. The occurrence event context therefore carries the raw numeric `schedule_type`. The same code existed in `mark_failed.py` before this PR, and the PR moves it as is, so this is not a regression. Since the function is being relocated anyway, either return `config` (this matches what `MonitorSerializer` does at src/sentry/monitors/serializers.py:240-242) or delete the dead lines. Changing the payload would change what is sent to Kafka, so it may belong in a separate PR.

findings.title: Unused `logger` in the new modules
findings.body: `logger` is defined here and in `incidents.py:11`, and neither module uses it. The old `mark_failed.py` had the same unused-logger pattern, but the new modules need not copy it.

contracts.action: Move threshold and incident logic out of mark_failed.py into incidents.py (try_incident_threshold) and incident_occurrence.py (create_incident_occurrence and helpers). Move SimpleCheckIn to types.py.
contracts.equivalent_path: The previous in-file `mark_failed_threshold` / `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, which the diff removes verbatim.
contracts.before_after: mark_failed still does the same steps in the same order: compute next check-in, conditional update of MonitorEnvironment, refresh_from_db, then call the threshold function. The moved bodies are line-for-line identical apart from the rename create_issue_platform_occurrence -> create_incident_occurrence, and the lazy imports of sentry.signals, sentry.issues.issue_occurrence and sentry.issues.producer are kept inside the functions. A grep of the repo finds no remaining references to the old names. Callers (monitor_consumer, check_timeout, check_missed) import only `mark_failed`. Tests patch `sentry.issues.producer.produce_occurrence_to_kafka`, which is still resolved at call time through the lazy import, so those patches still apply.
contracts.visible_effect: None. Incident creation, occurrence content and the monitor_environment_failed signal are unchanged.
contracts.failure_mode: No new async calls or I/O. A circular-import risk exists because incidents.py imports incident_occurrence at module level, which imports sentry.issues.grouptype. mark_failed.py previously imported that module at top level too, so the import graph is not worse.

summary: This is a mechanical refactor. The threshold and occurrence code moves out of mark_failed.py into incidents.py and incident_occurrence.py, and SimpleCheckIn moves to types.py. The moved logic matches the removed code, apart from the rename to create_incident_occurrence. No stale references to the old names remain, and the test patch targets still resolve. The only findings are minor: a dead `config` copy in get_monitor_environment_context, which the diff moves as it was, and unused loggers.
